critical_code_review_comments: Minor: React hydration warning in CryptoMarketPage table - <span> wrapper around <tr> elements causes hydration mismatch. Consider using React.Fragment instead of span for dynamic table rows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CoinGecko integration fully tested and working. Three endpoints: GET /api/market/crypto (50 coins, cached 120s), GET /api/market/global (global stats, cached 180s), GET /api/market/trending (trending coins/categories, cached 600s). Rate limiting handled gracefully - returns cached data or empty array. Email notification system uses APScheduler to send 20 emails per minute to users with balance > 0, with 48h cooldown. Logs stored in email_notifications_log collection with type 'balance_available'.
